$comment: Golden retrieval queries for the search-quality eval (sploot-073). Each query is written the way a person actually remembers a meme — plain words, no template names where avoidable. `expected` lists imgflip template ids from the committed fixture library (eval/fixtures/assets.json) that count as a correct hit; multiple ids are allowed when the library contains near-duplicate templates (e.g. two Bernie templates, two Megamind crops). Edit this file by hand, then run `pnpm --filter web eval:fixtures` to re-embed queries.
